note: CHN = additional US tariff on most goods from China (and Hong Kong, Macau) introduced since 2025, in percent: IEEPA 'fentanyl' duties 10% from 4 Feb 2025 (EO 14195) and 20% from 4 Mar 2025 (EO 14228), cut to 10% from 10 Nov 2025 (EO 14357); IEEPA reciprocal 10% from 5 Apr, 84% on 9 Apr (EO 14259), 125% from 10 Apr (EO 14266), 10% from 14 May 2025 (EO 14298, after the Geneva joint statement of 12 May; the remaining 24 points stayed suspended, EO 14334 and 14358); all IEEPA duties ended 24 Feb 2026 (Supreme Court, 20 Feb 2026; EO 14389); Section 122 surcharge 10% 24 Feb-24 Jul 2026 (Proclamation 11012); Section 301 'forced labour' tariff 12.5% from 24 Jul 2026 (USTR FR 2026-15181). Excludes the Section 301 tariffs of 2018-19 (7.5-25% on about two-thirds of imports from China, raised to up to 100% on some goods in 2024) and Section 232 sector tariffs, which apply on top. USA = China's additional tariff on all goods from the US: 34% announced 4 Apr and raised to 84% before it took effect on 10 Apr (State Council Tariff Commission), 125% from 12 Apr, 10% from 14 May 2025 (24 points suspended; suspension extended for a year from 10 Nov 2025, Tariff Commission announcement 2025 No. 10). Not shown: China's targeted tariffs of 10-15% on coal, LNG, crude oil, farm machinery and cars (from 10 Feb 2025) and on US farm goods (10 Mar 2025, lifted 10 Nov 2025). China's line stops at 20 Feb 2026: no official notice changing the 10% was found, so its later level is not shown. Step points: the day before each change repeats the old rate.
